sanskrit_verse:
चरित्रबन्धककृतं स वृद्ध्या दापयेद् धनम् ।
सत्यंकारकृतं द्रव्यं द्विगुणं प्रतिदापयेत् ॥
transliteration: caritrabandhakakṛtaṃ sa vṛddhyā dāpayed dhanam / satyaṃkārakṛtaṃ dravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ pratidāpayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who causes loss through breach of conduct shall repay the principal with interest; one who causes loss through false affirmation shall restore double the value.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation: Direct consequence of action determines restitution scope
Capacity-based responsibility: Awareness and intent modulate repayment obligation
Restoration logic: Loss must be reversed in full, including opportunity cost
Consciousness alignment: Truth-affirming acts carry higher energetic consequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF a party breaches ethical-conduct duty AND causes measurable loss THEN obligate principal plus accrued interest repayment
IF a party affirms untruth knowingly AND causes loss THEN obligate double-value restitution
IF restitution capacity is impaired THEN initiate completion process until alignment is restored
IF no intent is present THEN reduce obligation to principal-only restoration
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating financial or reputational harm, the Supreme Court must distinguish between violations rooted in character failure versus those involving deliberate falsification. The former invokes simple compensation with interest; the latter demands double restitution to restore systemic integrity and individual consciousness alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that untruth-affirmation disrupts universal śuddhi more than mere negligence. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how falsehood distorts both karmic and social balance. Responsibility is proportional to clarity of awareness. No punitive intent is required—only correction of energetic misalignment through conscious restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate dharmic inquiry to assess awareness level at time of act
Assign repayment plan aligned with current capacity and future earning potential
Implement sākṣāt-kriyā process to realign with truth-consciousness
Establish witness affirmation protocol to prevent recurrence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from truth-consciousness. Restitution aligns the actor with their inherent integrity. There is no punishment—only completion. The Supreme Pontiff is the sole Source. Dharma is restored.
